Plot a mort_forecast object

Source: R/methods.R
plot.mort_forecast.Rd

Plot a mort_forecast object

Usage

# S3 method for class 'mort_forecast'
plot(
  x,
  type = c("trends", "trends_by_age", "age", "pi", "residuals", "smoothing",
    "components", "model_comparison", "disagg"),
  group = NULL,
  facet_by = NULL,
  color_by = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

x

A mort_forecast object.

type

One of "trends" (age-averaged trends with PIs), "trends_by_age" (trends faceted by age group), "age" (age profiles for forecast years), "pi" (PI fan chart), "residuals" (residual diagnostics), "smoothing" (observed vs smoothed), "components" (Tucker3 B-mode temporal components), "model_comparison" (bar chart from calibration), or "disagg" (single-year disaggregated profiles).

group

Integer index to show a single group, or NULL (default) for all groups.

facet_by

Character vector of column names from the groups data.frame to use for faceting. If NULL (default), auto-detected from group structure: when groups have 2+ columns, the first columns are used for faceting.

color_by

Character column name from the groups data.frame to map to the colour aesthetic. If NULL (default), auto-detected: the last column of the groups data.frame is used.

...

Additional arguments passed to ggplot.

Value

A ggplot object (invisibly).
